user.title: Park and Ride
user.description: This integration uses the official Transport for NSW Open Data Car Park API, which needs a free API key. Sign up at {portal_url}, create an application, add the Car Park API to it, and paste the key here.

data_description.api_key: The key from your Open Data Hub application. Pasting the whole 'apikey ...' value also works.

car_parks.title: Choose car parks
car_parks.description: Choose the Park&Ride car parks to track. You can change this later.

data_description.car_parks: One or more car parks. Each becomes a device with its own sensors.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to check for new availability, in minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Update your API key
reauth_confirm.description: Transport NSW rejected the saved API key. Enter a working key from {portal_url}.

error.invalid_auth: Transport NSW rejected that API key. Check it is copied in full and that your application has the Car Park API added.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Transport NSW (or it is rate limiting requests). Try again shortly.
error.unexpected_response: Transport NSW answered, but in a format this integration doesn't understand. See the integration's debug log.
error.no_car_parks: Select at least one car park.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Park and Ride is already set up. Use Configure on the existing entry to change car parks.

data_description.car_parks: Un-ticking a car park removes its device and sensors.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to check for new availability, in minutes.

error.no_car_parks: Select at least one car park.

abort.invalid_auth: Transport NSW rejected the saved API key. Re-authenticate from the integration page.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Transport NSW. Try again shortly.
abort.unexpected_response: Transport NSW answered in a format this integration doesn't understand.
